text:
Sharing - Renewal of darkon within 1 year of getting citizenship

As discussed in this group, the first darkon after getting citizenship is almost always valid for 1 year only.

I got mine September 2025, valid until September 2026.

I optimistically want to fly for a vacation in July/August. The current darkon will not have enough months left on validity for it to be useful in said optimistic dates.

So, I booked a passport renewal in order to have a useable darkon. I paid online using the winter rate in order to save some shekels.

When I got to the clerk, she reminded me that I'm going to get just another 1 year valid darkon and asked if maybe I would prefer to wait for September before renewing it. So I told her that I am aware of that and the entire reasoning I mentioned above on why I wanted to renew now, and that I don't mind paying for a darkon with short validity as long as I have something to use in July/August. 

Here's the part where l don't know if I got lucky with the clerk or if it's the protocol - She processed the renewal and at the end she said that I don't need to pay since it's essentially just prolonging of the validity. She said I can either apply for refund online on the payment I made, or just leave it there and use it for next renewal since it will just stay in the system for years (paying onsite for difference if needed). 

So that's the part that was new to me. The not needing to pay when renewing your first 1-year-valid darkon before it expires.

I have another friend who said she was also not asked to pay when she renewed within the 1st year of her first darkon after getting citizenship.
